objective.formula: H(x)=sum_i h_i*x_i+sum_ij J_ij*x_i*x_j+sum_ijk K_ijk*x_i*x_j*x_k under fixed cardinality k
objective.linear_coefficient: mean singleton utility over the three outer-train scaffold blocks
objective.pair_coefficient: signed stable pair Mobius residual U(ij)-U(i)-U(j)
objective.per_ligand_weight: w(r)=exp(-alpha*r), where r is the outer-train empirical receptor rank fraction and lower is better
objective.quadratization: Each retained cubic term is reduced exactly with a Rosenberg product auxiliary and quadratic consistency penalty; no quadratization or hardware execution occurs in Stage40.
objective.set_utility: For each seed and the median-seed consensus, mean active weight minus mean decoy weight; robust utility is the equal mean of consensus, mean-seed, and worst-seed contrasts.
objective.triplet_coefficient: signed stable third-order Mobius residual after subtracting all singleton and pair contributions
